descriptions.webhooks_delete: Permanently delete a webhook subscription from a base. Required positional args: base (Airtable base ID, appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) and webhook (webhook ID, achXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Destructive: removes the webhook and stops further payload delivery; recorded payloads remain accessible via webhooks_list-payloads until they age out. Returns an empty object on success. Use webhooks_refresh instead if the goal is to extend an expiring webhook rather than tear it down.
